name: Anna Strolenberg - § 74/1
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: ‘Condemns in the strongest terms the use of rape and other forms of sexual violence as a weapon of war, and recalls that such conduct can amount to war crimes or crimes against humanity under international law; urges the strengthening of international efforts to document these crimes’
